description:
The embodiment of capitalism's ultimate pinnacle, the top 1% known as Suin. 

Kim Nam-Ju, the ultimate cat otaku who adored Cheese Nyan. He was completely absorbed in *The Forest of Yarn*, a vicarious satisfaction game featuring Suin. That is, until he picked up the abandoned kitten Sui-In in front of his house... A bright yellow kitten with a fluffy head, Cheese Nyan. In other words, it was a kitten identical to the companion Suin from the game!! Their cohabitation began as temporary care for the babbling kitten. But this little guy. Before he knew it, he started calling him “Dad”...? And even though Mr. Kim Nam-Ju, the otaku, was a first-time dad, he ended up responsible for his companion Suin's first heat cycle...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
